key: When the mother is found, we know what her children should be. When one knows that he is his mother’s child, and proceeds to guard (the qualities of) the mother that belong to him, to the end of his life he will be free from all peril.
s: After naming the source of all under the sky their mother, the chapter turns to her children; Wang Bi, on chapter 52, reads the mother as root and the children as branches: the root grasped to know the branches, never forsaken to chase them.
src: Wang Bi, Laozi zhu, chapter 52, zh.wikisource (the Huating Zhang edition), revision 2354026 (2024)

evidence.words: 母，本也，子，末也。得本以知末，不舍本以逐末也。
evidence.gloss: The mother is the root; the children are the branches. Grasp the root in order to know the branches; do not forsake the root to chase the branches.
